subject: Create HANA-specific Pydantic I/O models
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/models/hana.py` with Pydantic input/output models for HANA-specific tools.

Models to create:

**Calculation View models:**
- `CalcViewInfo`: name, schema_name, column_count, is_valid (bool), columns (optional list[ColumnInfo])
- `ListCalcViewsOutput`: views (list[CalcViewInfo]), schema_name, count, note (str, about analytic privileges)

**Store Type models:**
- `StoreTypeInfo`: table_name, schema_name, store_type ("COLUMN" or "ROW"), is_column_table (bool), partition_info (str | None), compression_status (str | None), implications (str)
- `GetStoreTypeOutput`: info (StoreTypeInfo)

**Procedure models:**
- `ProcedureParam`: name, data_type, direction ("IN" | "OUT" | "INOUT"), position
- `ProcedureInfo`: name, schema_name, procedure_type (str), parameter_count, parameters (optional list[ProcedureParam])
- `ListProceduresOutput`: procedures (list[ProcedureInfo]), schema_name, count

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] All HANA-specific output models defined
- [ ] `CalcViewInfo` optionally includes column metadata
- [ ] `StoreTypeInfo` includes human-readable implications text
- [ ] `ProcedureInfo` optionally includes parameter details
- [ ] All models serializable for MCP transport

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Optional column lists default to None/empty
- [ ] Procedure with no parameters: empty parameter list

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Model instantiation with valid data
• Unit: Optional field handling (columns, parameters)

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.4, 9.3
